Validate a panel

Source: R/pks_validate.R
pks_validate.Rd

Runs the consistency checks of the pksR-data validation gate that need only the panel itself: schema, uniqueness, coverage and plausibility. Use it after filtering, joining or editing data from pks_get(). The checks of national totals and conservation need the national tables and run in the pipeline before every release.

Usage

pks_validate(data)

Arguments

data

A tibble from pks_get().

Value

A tibble with one row per check: check, status (pass, warn or fail), problems (number of offending rows or years) and details.

Details

Checks:

  • schema: the columns of the data as published or harmonized, with their types.

  • uniqueness: one row per year, ags and offence_key.

  • city_states: Berlin (11000) and Hamburg (02000) present in every year.

  • coverage: harmonized data have the same districts in every year (balanced panel).

  • counts: no negative counts, and attempts not above cases.

  • population: the median district population per year lies between 50,000 and 400,000 (a warning otherwise).

Deutsch

Prüft ein Panel auf Schema, Eindeutigkeit (eine Zeile je Jahr, Kreis und Schlüssel), Vorhandensein von Berlin und Hamburg in jedem Jahr, gleichen Kreisbestand in harmonisierten Daten, keine negativen Zahlen, nicht mehr Versuche als Fälle und plausible Einwohnerzahlen. Ergebnis: ein Tibble mit einer Zeile je Prüfung und dem Status pass, warn oder fail.

See also

Other analysis: pks_rates()

Examples

pks_validate(pks_example())
#> Validation: 6 passed, 0 warnings, 0 failed.
#> # A tibble: 6 × 4
#>   check       status problems details
#>   <chr>       <chr>     <int> <chr>  
#> 1 schema      pass          0 ""     
#> 2 uniqueness  pass          0 ""     
#> 3 city_states pass          0 ""     
#> 4 coverage    pass          0 ""     
#> 5 counts      pass          0 ""     
#> 6 population  pass          0 ""
